div.head: Af 11.4
div.ab: Gif mon teo hy, geladige hy be LX hida, oþþe ðolie be healfre ðære bote.
Gif hie mon teo, geladiege hie be sixtegum hida, oððe ðolige be healfre þære bote.
Si accusetur inde, adlegiet se per LX hidas, uel dimidium emendationis amittat.
Gif he mon teo, geladie (ge)hie be sixtegum hida, oððe ðolige be healfe þære bote.
If she is accused [of having lain with another man], let her clear herself by [an oath in the value of] sixty hides, or forfeit half the compensation.
If she is accused [of having previously lain with a man], she shall clear herself by [an oath of] 60 hides, or lose half the compensation due to her.
Wenn sie [solch früherer Unkeuschheit] geziehen wird, reinige sie sich mit [Eid von] 60 Hiden, oder gehe [des Empfangs] jener Busse um die Hälfte verlustig.
If she is accused [of such earlier unchastity], let her clear herself with [an oath of] 60 hides, or lose half of that compensation.
